name: Noachian-Rift
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by massive canyon systems. Beyond a nearby asteroid belt, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.

The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking. Sampler drones return with spore-forming microbes that survive direct exposure to open sky.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
